summary: bound.PageOptions/mcpPageConfig carry a FirstPageOnlyFields list; workouts_list sets it to ["summary"]. A named field is kept only on a query's very first page (no incoming cursor) and dropped from every later page, so workouts_list's per-month workout histogram (confirmed live at ~1.5 KB) stops being repeated fixed overhead on every page a caller pages through. A regen touching workouts_list's mcpPageConfig must keep this set.
reason: Live retesting found summary present unchanged on every cursor page of workouts_list, useful once on page 1 and pure repeated cost afterward -- flagged as an easy byte win on the one endpoint (workouts) whose sync/archive path is still unexercised in live testing.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. TestEndpointPageResponseFirstPageOnlyFieldsDroppedOnLaterPages drives a first-page/second-page pair through the real EndpointPageResponse call path and asserts summary present on page one, absent on page two, with other fields (total) unaffected on both.
